Overview

Bunbury is a city in Western Australia with a population of 75,196. Western Australia’s port city with stunning beaches, the Dolphin Discovery Centre, and the Ferguson Valley wine region. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
